topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: When I found out that my childhood best friend doesn't remember me, it felt like a piece of me was missing, but I took a deep breath and reminded myself that memories can fade over time. It’s a natural part of life, like leaves falling from trees in autumn. I decided to reach out anyway, sharing some of our old photos and stories, hoping to spark a connection. It’s not about making them remember every detail; it’s about rebuilding the friendship, bit by bit. I believe in the resilience of bonds, and I’m taking it one step at a time, with hope and patience.
